summary: AudioContext lifecycle methods return promises even though WebAudioHost exposes synchronous commands. Firefox qualification after the Playwright upgrade exposed a pending resume rejection when Dispose closed its context. Observe unlock, suspend, resume and close operations with their original context identity. Treat InvalidStateError as expected cancellation only after that context has been retired and is closed; preserve observation of unexpected failures. Browser regression controls use real AudioContexts with explicitly deferred operation promises, covering four disposal transitions and two unexpected-failure paths without weakening the normal pageerror guard.
title: Observe context-operation promises through Web Audio disposal
